why: The opening line carries the subscript from the reference pressure, making it character-for-character identical to the line beneath it and so asserting v_P = v_Po, which is what the example exists to disprove. The book contradicts itself two lines later, where its own working correctly writes sqrt(gamma P / rho) without the subscript. The final answer P = 2.25 P_o is right.

The penultimate line prints a stray leading plus and an equals sign where the addition belongs: as printed it reads '+ 10 (0.3876 = 6)', which is not an expression at all. It must be '= 10 (0.3876 + 6)', which is exactly what yields the printed 63.876 db.
